title: Does AI Generate Secure Code? Tackling AppSec in the Face of AI Dev Acceleration & Prompt Injection.
description:
In this episode of the AI Native Dev Podcast, host Guy Podjarny welcomes Caleb Sima, a seasoned expert in cybersecurity and AI. Caleb's impressive background includes founding Spy Dynamics and serving as the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) at Databricks and Robinhood. Currently, he's making waves on the investment side with WhiteRabbit and co-hosting a podcast on AI security.

Chapters:

00:21 Intro – Guy Podjarny welcomes Caleb Sima for a chat on AI security.
01:01 Caleb’s Path – From Spy Dynamics to Robinhood: Caleb’s career highlights.
01:52 Is AI Code Secure? – Can AI write safe, secure code?
03:29 Systematic AI Code – AI code creation meets security testing.
05:21 AI's Role for Devs – How AI-generated secure code helps developers.
12:31 Consistency in AI – Ensuring consistent security in AI systems.
18:12 Trusting AI – Building trust in AI through learning and accountability.
31:11 Prompt Injection – Breaking down this major AI security threat.
45:38 Data Poisoning – Defending against data poisoning in AI.
50:52 AI & AppSec’s Future – Caleb's take on the future of AppSec with AI.
